detections.mission_name: Unusual Login Frequency and Transaction Patterns
detections.sql:
SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name, COUNT(t.txn_id) AS txn_count, COUNT(le.event_id) AS login_count 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
WHERE t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
AND t.created_at <= date('now') 
AND le.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
AND le.created_at <= date('now') 
AND u.risk_level = 'EXTREMELY LOW' 
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.full_name 
HAVING COUNT(t.txn_id) > 50 AND COUNT(le.event_id) < 2 
AND t.created_at NOT LIKE '% %'

detections.mission_name: Payment Failure Rate by Payment Method and User Risk Level
detections.sql:
SELECT 
  t.payment_method, 
  u.risk_level, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN le.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, 
  COUNT(*) AS total_count, 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN le.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) * 1.0) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
  JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
WHERE 
  le.status = 'FAILED' 
  AND t.status = 'FAILED'
GROUP BY 
  t.payment_method, 
  u.risk_level

detections.sql:
SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument = i.instrument THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / 
       SUM(t.amount_usd) AS concentration_ratio, 
       CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument = i.instrument THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / 
              SUM(t.amount_usd) > 0.9 THEN 'FLAGGED' ELSE 'OK' END AS risk_status
FROM users u
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id
JOIN (
  SELECT instrument, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_volume
  FROM transactions
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
  GROUP BY instrument
) i ON t.instrument = i.instrument
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.full_name
